name: Koyadori Shino
source:
Goal: To return to her figure from long ago and wear her past clothing.

A housewife who lives near the gym. After seeing a flyer, she looks into going to the gym. She is the type to look thin with clothes on, but when she changes into her training wear you can see her plumpness.

She wants to be able to dress up in fashionable clothes and have her husband see her as a woman again.
As she used to be a day care worker, she has a strong maternal instinct.
